eyebrow: The arithmetic nobody runs until it's too late
code:
Northbeam: 2,000,000 requests / day
800 input tokens + 200 output tokens, each

Daily cost:     $10,800
Annual cost:    $3,942,000
caption: Nearly $4M a year, at steady state -- for a feature that looked free as a 50-user pilot.

eyebrow: Why a "small" prompt change isn't small
code:
+400 tokens added to the system prompt
(a few extra examples -- looks harmless in review)

Extra daily cost:      $2,400
Extra annual cost:     $876,000
caption: A change that would pass code review without a second glance costs $876K a year.

eyebrow: A target, split across the whole request path
Why these budgets come before building
code:
Budgets set AFTER building:
   every fix is now a redesign

Budgets set BEFORE building:
   the constraint shapes the design from day one
caption: By the time code exists, the expensive decisions are usually already locked in.
